sentences.text: Albertosuchus holds the record as the northernmost Late Cretaceous crocodylian known from North America.
The species Albertosuchus knudsenii was named in 2015 based on fossils found in the Scollard Formation of Alberta.
This animal lived in Canada during the Late Cretaceous period.
It existed between 72.2 and 66 million years ago during the Maastrichtian stage.
Scientists consider the classification of Albertosuchus as a close relative of Arenysuchus uncertain due to the incomplete nature of the known fossil material.
